variants.name: 400 g
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Tuna (65%), potato starch, fish oil (salmon oil 2%), yeast products (1%, hydrolysed, of which free nucleotides 44%), minerals, xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS 0.4%), psyllium seeds (0.2%). Carbohydrate source: potato starch.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 9.5%, crude fibre: 1.5%, crude fat: 2%, crude ash: 1.8%, moisture: 80%, starch: 2.2%, total sugars: 0.1%. Metabolisable energy: 685 kcal/kg.

Additives: Nutritional additives/kg: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 4,375 IU, Vitamin D3 245 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 29 mg, zinc (zinc oxide 20 mg) 16 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: FEEDING INSTRUCTIONS: It is recommended to seek veterinary advice before use and before extending the period of use. Recommended duration of use: until target body weight is achieved and thereafter if necessary to maintain ideal body weight. For regulation of glucose supply (diabetes mellitus): initially up to 6 months. For effective weight loss or maintenance of ideal body weight, the recommended daily energy intake should not be exceeded. Recommended daily feeding amounts (see table) may be divided into 2 meals. Serve at room temperature. After opening, store in the refrigerator and consume within 24 hours. *May contain traces of other protein sources. Pet food only, not suitable for human consumption.
